spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
    "Categoria_Riesgo" AS category,
    COUNT(*) AS total
FROM students
GROUP BY "Categoria_Riesgo"
ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT
    'Grades' AS categoria,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Total_Score" >= 90) AS "A (≥90)",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Total_Score" >= 80 AND "Total_Score" < 90) AS "B (80-90)",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Total_Score" >= 70 AND "Total_Score" < 80) AS "C (70-80)",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Total_Score" >= 60 AND "Total_Score" < 70) AS "D (60-70)",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Total_Score" < 60) AS "F (<60)"
FROM students
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total Estudiantes" FROM students
SELECT ROUND(AVG("Total_Score")::numeric, 2) AS "Promedio Score" FROM students

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Categoria_Riesgo" = 'Alto') / COUNT(*), 1) AS "% Riesgo Alto"
FROM students

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Total_Score" < 60) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "% Reprobados"
FROM students

SELECT 
    "Department",
    ROUND(AVG("Total_Score")::numeric, 2) AS promedio_score
FROM students
GROUP BY "Department"
ORDER BY promedio_score DESC

spec.title: Tasa de Reprobacion por Nivel de Estres

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
    CONCAT('Nivel ', CAST("Stress_Level (1-10)" AS TEXT)) AS nivel_estres,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "Total_Score" < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS tasa_reprobacion
FROM students
GROUP BY "Stress_Level (1-10)"
ORDER BY "Stress_Level (1-10)"

spec.title: Score Promedio por Ingresos y Acceso a Internet

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
    CASE "Family_Income_Level" 
        WHEN 'Low' THEN '1-Low'
        WHEN 'Medium' THEN '2-Medium'
        WHEN 'High' THEN '3-High'
    END AS ingresos,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "Internet_Access_at_Home" = 'Yes' THEN "Total_Score" END)::numeric, 2) AS "Con Internet",
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "Internet_Access_at_Home" = 'No' THEN "Total_Score" END)::numeric, 2) AS "Sin Internet"
FROM students
GROUP BY "Family_Income_Level"
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Eficiencia y Horas de Estudio por Categoria de Riesgo

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
    "Categoria_Riesgo",
    ROUND(AVG("Eficiencia_Estudio")::numeric, 2) AS "Eficiencia Promedio",
    ROUND(AVG("Study_Hours_per_Week")::numeric, 2) AS "Horas Promedio"
FROM students
GROUP BY "Categoria_Riesgo"
ORDER BY "Eficiencia Promedio" DESC
